svg.title: A plane learning to align
svg.desc: A solid, lit plane learns to align with a fixed dashed target plane. Three replayed rollouts from the same misaligned pose, early, middle and late in training: the early policy wobbles and overshoots, the middle one reaches the target with some overshoot and the late one settles smoothly, flashing red with an aligned tag. A learning curve with a marker and a live error readout sit on the right.
